name: Saved desktop layouts
author: aishag80g-stack
description: One click restores your favorite desktop: apps launch, windows land in place at their saved size. A layout for each workspace — work, study, play.

barWidget.description: Left-click restores your saved desktop: missing apps launch on their own, every window lands exactly where you placed it, at exactly the size you set. Keep a saved layout for each thing you do — work, study, gaming — and switch your whole desktop in one click. Define layouts with the bundled CLI (from a screenshot or the current desktop); geometry is relative, so it works at any resolution.
